decisions.reason: It is closely tied to the firm’s core travel-security offer, has visible external validation and government use, and prior investment and public commitment make management likely to continue backing it.

It remains publicly offered after launch, fits the firm’s integrated border and travel-compliance services, and with no clear failure signal management is likely to justify past investment and keep it on the market.

It is close to the established business, still presented on its own page, and in an expanding firm and growing market escalation of commitment favors retention unless performance clearly deteriorates.
